city.Kuwait.description: This small, very hot desert country at the head of the Persian Gulf is famous for its oil wealth and gleaming towers, and for a history of pearl diving and building wooden sailing boats called dhows.
city.Kuwait.landmark: blue-green spheres of the Kuwait Towers rising over the Persian Gulf
city.Kuwait.flag: green, white, and red stripes with a black shape near the pole
city.Kuwait.clue.0: kept talking about heading to a tiny, super-hot country right at the top of the Persian Gulf
city.Kuwait.clue.1: kept fanning against the heat and joking about visiting one of the hottest places on Earth
city.Kyrgyzstan.description: This mountainous country in Central Asia is covered by the towering Tian Shan range and known for round felt tents called yurts, horseback herders, and a huge alpine lake that never freezes.
city.Kyrgyzstan.landmark: white yurts and grazing horses on a green alpine pasture beside a mountain lake
city.Kyrgyzstan.flag: studied a flag in a guidebook: bright red with a yellow sun and a little round yurt-roof design in the center
city.Kyrgyzstan.clue.0: wanted to sleep in a round felt tent called a yurt out on a grassy mountain pasture
city.Kyrgyzstan.clue.1: was fascinated by hunters who ride horses with giant golden eagles perched on their arms
city.Laos.description: This landlocked country in Southeast Asia is threaded by the mighty Mekong River and known for golden temples, waterfalls tumbling through turquoise pools, and a mysterious plain scattered with giant ancient stone jars.
city.Laos.landmark: tiered turquoise pools of the Kuang Si Falls in the jungle
city.Laos.flag: red on top and bottom, blue in the middle, with a big white circle like a full moon
city.Laos.clue.0: couldn't wait to swim beneath waterfalls that tumble through pools of glowing turquoise water
city.Lebanon.description: This small country on the eastern shore of the Mediterranean Sea is famous for its towering cedar trees, the ancient port city of Byblos, and the giant Roman temples at Baalbek.
city.Lebanon.landmark: ancient grove of towering cedar trees on a misty mountain slope
city.Lebanon.greeting: Most people speak Arabic — say hello with “Marhaba” (mar-HA-ba).
city.Lebanon.flag: red and white stripes with a single green cedar tree in the middle
city.Lebanon.clue.0: wanted to walk among ancient, towering cedar trees high in the misty mountains
city.Lebanon.clue.1: wanted to wander through Byblos, one of the oldest cities where people have always lived
city.Lebanon.clue.2: kept talking about enormous stone Roman temples at a place called Baalbek
city.Maldives.description: This tropical country is a chain of about 1,200 tiny coral islands scattered across the warm Indian Ocean. It is the flattest, lowest country on Earth, famous for turquoise water and overwater bungalows.
city.Maldives.landmark: aerial view of overwater bungalows on stilts above a turquoise lagoon
